image_description: A close-up shot of an ornate, bib-style statement necklace worn on a mannequin or model's neck. The necklace features intricate silver-tone filigree metalwork with swirling patterns, adorned with clusters of pink and peach-colored flower-shaped beads or stones, and scattered yellow/green faceted gemstones. The background is a soft-focus skin tone.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture is excessively smooth and airbrushed, lacking natural pore detail, which is common in AI generations but also possible in heavy photo editing. It has a slight 'waxy' appearance.

The pink flower elements on the right side appear to merge into the metal filigree without clear physical attachment points. Some petals seem to float or blend into the silver wire rather than sitting on top of it.
The outermost silver swirls on the left appear slightly warped and inconsistent in thickness compared to the rest of the symmetrical design, suggesting minor geometric instability.

To verify if the flowers and gems are physically distinct objects attached to the metal frame or if they suffer from fusion/melting artifacts.

focus_areas: Physical connectivity between beads/flowers and metal base
Consistency of metal thickness in filigree patterns

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' of the pink flowers into the silver metal. In real jewelry, these would be glued or set; in AI images, they often melt together. Also, evaluate if the skin texture is unnaturally uniform.
